chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/08_現在簡單式表未來用法
example: If the shipment is *behind schedule*, notify the client immediately.
exampleZh: 若出貨晚於計劃，請立即通知客戶。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/08_現在簡單式表未來用法#v-run-late
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/08_現在簡單式表未來用法
example: The connecting flight *runs late* whenever the first leg is delayed.
exampleZh: 只要第一航段延誤，轉機航班就會延誤。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/08_現在簡單式表未來用法#v-take-place
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/08_現在簡單式表未來用法
example: The annual shareholders' meeting *takes place* in the main auditorium.
exampleZh: 年度股東大會在主禮堂舉行。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/08_現在簡單式表未來用法#v-effective
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/08_現在簡單式表未來用法
example: The new dress code is *effective* the first day of next month.
exampleZh: 新的服裝要求將於下個月的第一天生效。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/08_現在簡單式表未來用法#v-whenever
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/08_現在簡單式表未來用法
example: The system sends an alert *whenever* stock levels fall below the threshold.
exampleZh: 當庫存水準低於閾值時，系統會發送警報。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/08_現在簡單式表未來用法#v-so-long-as
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/08_現在簡單式表未來用法
example: So long as the invoice *matches* the purchase order, payment proceeds automatically.
exampleZh: 只要發票與採購訂單相符，付款就會自動進行。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/08_現在簡單式表未來用法#v-in-case
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/08_現在簡單式表未來用法
example: Keep a backup generator ready *in case* the main power supply fails.
exampleZh: 準備好備用發電機，以防主電源故障。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/08_現在簡單式表未來用法#v-lest
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/08_現在簡單式表未來用法
example: The auditor reviews every entry twice *lest* an error slip through.
exampleZh: 審核員對每個條目進行兩次檢查，以免漏掉錯誤。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/08_現在簡單式表未來用法#v-insofar-as
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/08_現在簡單式表未來用法
example: The policy applies *insofar as* the employee remains on the payroll.
exampleZh: 只要僱員仍在薪資單上，該政策就適用。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-eligibility
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: Applicants must confirm their *eligibility* before submitting the form.
exampleZh: 申請人在提交表格之前必須確認自己的資格。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-entitlement
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: Employees lose their vacation *entitlement* if they resign before the anniversary date.
exampleZh: 如果員工在周年日之前辭職，他們將失去休假權利。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-clause
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: Please review the termination *clause* before signing.
exampleZh: 請在簽署前查看終止條款。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-provision
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: The agreement includes a *provision* for early cancellation.
exampleZh: 該協議包括提前取消的條款。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-proviso
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: The offer stands, with the *proviso* that stock remains available.
exampleZh: 報價保持不變，但條件是庫存仍然可用。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-criteria
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: Candidates who meet all the *criteria* will be shortlisted.
exampleZh: 符合所有標準的候選人將被列入入圍名單。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-threshold
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: Orders that exceed the *threshold* qualify for free shipping.
exampleZh: 超過門檻的訂單有資格享受免費送貨。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-subject-to
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: The proposal is *subject to* approval by the board.
exampleZh: 該提案須經董事會批准。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-applicable
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: This discount is *applicable* only to first-time customers.
exampleZh: 此折扣僅適用於首次購買的客戶。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-breach
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: Late delivery would *breach* the terms of the agreement.
exampleZh: 延遲交貨將違反協議條款。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-waive
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: The landlord agreed to *waive* the late fee this once.
exampleZh: 房東這次同意免收滯納金。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-waiver
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: Customers must sign a *waiver* before joining the trial program.
exampleZh: 客戶在加入試用計畫之前必須簽署棄權書。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-forfeit
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: Guests who cancel late will *forfeit* their deposit.
exampleZh: 逾期取消預訂的客人將被沒收押金。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-void
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: Any unauthorized change will *void* the warranty.
exampleZh: 任何未經授權的更改都會導致保固失效。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-null-and-void
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: The clause becomes *null and void* if either party breaches the agreement.
exampleZh: 如果任何一方違反協議，則該條款無效。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-revoke
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: The company reserves the right to *revoke* access at any time.
exampleZh: 本公司保留隨時撤銷存取權限的權利。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-amend
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: Management may *amend* the policy with prior notice.
exampleZh: 管理層可能會在事先通知的情況下修改政策。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-amendment
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: The latest *amendment* takes effect next quarter.
exampleZh: 最新修正案將於下個季度生效。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-binding
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: Once signed, the contract is legally *binding* on both parties.
exampleZh: 合約一經簽署，對雙方均具有法律約束力。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-default
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: Unless changed, the system will *default* to monthly billing.
exampleZh: 除非更改，系統將預設按月計費。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-contingency
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: The department created a *contingency* plan for supply shortages.
exampleZh: 該部門制定了供應短缺應急計劃。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-safeguard
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: These measures *safeguard* customer data in case of a breach.
exampleZh: 這些措施可以在發生外洩時保護客戶資料。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-reimburse
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: The company will *reimburse* travel expenses provided receipts are submitted.
exampleZh: 只要提交收據，公司將報銷差旅費。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-non-refundable
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: The registration fee is *non-refundable* after the deadline.
exampleZh: 截止日期後，報名費將不予退還。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-opt-out
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: Employees may *opt out* of the program at any time.
exampleZh: 員工可以隨時選擇退出該計劃。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識#v-unless-otherwise-specified
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/09_時態與條件句搭配辨識
example: All prices include tax *unless otherwise specified*.
exampleZh: 除非另有說明，所有價格均含稅。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-transform
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The team **transformed** the manual process into an automated workflow.
exampleZh: 該團隊將手動流程轉變為自動化工作流程。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-convert
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The firm plans to **convert** the warehouse into office space.
exampleZh: 該公司計劃將倉庫改造成辦公空間。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-rewrite
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The editor was asked to **rewrite** the press release before publication.
exampleZh: 編輯被要求在發布前重寫新聞稿。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-restructure
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The company will **restructure** its sales division next quarter.
exampleZh: 該公司將於下個季度重組其銷售部門。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-rearrange
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The assistant had to **rearrange** the schedule after the client canceled.
exampleZh: 客戶取消後，助理不得不重新安排日程。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-reorganize
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: Management decided to **reorganize** the entire filing system.
exampleZh: 管理階層決定重組整個檔案系統。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-modify
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The engineer **modified** the design after receiving customer feedback.
exampleZh: 工程師在收到客戶回饋後修改了設計。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-alter
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The contract terms **were altered** shortly before signing.
exampleZh: 合約條款在簽署前不久進行了更改。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-anonymous
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The complaint was submitted by an **anonymous** employee.
exampleZh: 該投訴是由一位匿名員工提交的。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-unspecified
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The budget cut was attributed to **unspecified** reasons.
exampleZh: 預算削減的原因不明。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-unidentified
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: An **unidentified** caller reported the security breach.
exampleZh: 一位身份不明的來電者報告了安全漏洞。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-undisclosed
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The deal was reportedly financed by an **undisclosed** investor.
exampleZh: 據報道，該交易由一位未透露姓名的投資者提供資金。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-on-behalf-of
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The lawyer signed the document **on behalf of** the client.
exampleZh: 律師代表委託人簽署了該文件。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-collectively
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The decision was made **collectively** by the department heads.
exampleZh: 此決定由各部門負責人集體作出。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-attribute-a-to-b
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
meaning: 將 A 歸因於 B
example: The sales increase was **attributed to** the new marketing campaign.
exampleZh: 銷售額的成長歸功於新的行銷活動。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-credit-a-with-b
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: Analysts **credited** the CEO with the company's rapid recovery.
exampleZh: 分析師將公司的快速復甦歸功於執行長。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-stem-from
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The dispute **stemmed from** a misunderstanding about delivery terms.
exampleZh: 糾紛源自於對交貨條款的誤解。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-originate-from
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The idea for the product line **originated from** a customer survey.
exampleZh: 該產品線的想法源自於一次客戶調查。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-be-blamed-for
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The contractor **was blamed for** the construction delay.
exampleZh: 承包商因施工延誤而受到指責。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-take-credit-for
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The manager should not **take credit for** the entire team's effort.
exampleZh: 經理不應該將整個團隊的努力歸功於自己。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-draft
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The contract was first **drafted** by the legal department.
exampleZh: 該合約首先由法律部門起草。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-wrap
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: All fragile items are **wrapped** with protective foam.
exampleZh: 所有易碎物品都用保護泡沫包裹。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-seal
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The envelope was **sealed** with wax before shipping.
exampleZh: 信封在運送前用蠟密封。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-compile
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The annual report was **compiled** by three different departments.
exampleZh: 此年度報告由三個不同部門編制。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-assemble
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The furniture is **assembled** with a set of included tools.
exampleZh: 家具是用一組隨附的工具組裝的。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-certify
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The financial statements were **certified** by an independent auditor.
exampleZh: 財務報表由獨立審計師認證。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-endorse
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The proposal was **endorsed** by the entire executive committee.
exampleZh: 該提案得到了整個執行委員會的認可。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-noteworthy
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The improvement in customer retention was particularly **noteworthy**.
exampleZh: 客戶保留率的提高尤其值得注意。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-negligible
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The impact of the price change was considered **negligible**.
exampleZh: 價格變動的影響被認為可以忽略不計。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-decisive
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The chairman's vote proved **decisive** in the final outcome.
exampleZh: 主席的投票對最終結果具有決定性作用。

id: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略#v-incidental
chapterId: grammar/02_動詞時態與語態/10_語態轉換與行為者省略
example: The extra cost was treated as **incidental** to the main project.
exampleZh: 額外費用被視為主要項目的附帶費用。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-intend
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
example: We **intend to** expand our operations next year.
exampleZh: 我們打算明年擴展業務。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-refuse
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
example: He **refused to** sign the agreement.
exampleZh: 他拒絕簽署這份協議。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-afford
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
meaning: can/cannot 連用） 負擔得起
example: We cannot **afford to** delay the shipment.
exampleZh: 我們無法承擔延遲出貨的後果。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-hesitate
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
example: Please do not **hesitate to** contact us.
exampleZh: 請不要猶豫，隨時與我們聯絡。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-strive
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
example: The company **strives to** improve customer service.
exampleZh: 這家公司致力於改善客戶服務。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-eager
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
example: She is **eager to** learn new skills.
exampleZh: 她渴望學習新技能。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-reluctant
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
example: He was **reluctant to** accept the offer.
exampleZh: 他不太願意接受這個提議。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-eligible
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
example: Employees are **eligible to** apply for the program.
exampleZh: 員工有資格申請這項計畫。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-likely
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
example: The price is **likely to** increase next month.
exampleZh: 價格下個月很可能會上漲。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-in-order-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
example: We hired more staff **in order to** meet the deadline.
exampleZh: 為了趕上期限，我們增聘了人手。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-so-as-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
example: The manager arrived early **so as to** prepare the meeting room.
exampleZh: 經理提早到，好把會議室準備好。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-be-supposed-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
example: The report **is supposed to** be finished by Friday.
exampleZh: 這份報告應該要在週五前完成。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-be-scheduled-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
example: The flight **is scheduled to** depart at noon.
exampleZh: 這班飛機預定中午起飛。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞#v-too...to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/01_不定詞
example: The box is **too heavy to** carry alone.
exampleZh: 這個箱子太重，一個人搬不動。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-avoid
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: We should **avoid** *making* the same mistake twice.
exampleZh: 我們應該避免重蹈覆轍。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-suggest
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: The consultant **suggested** *restructuring* the department.
exampleZh: 顧問建議重整這個部門。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-consider
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: Please **consider** *joining* our new project team.
exampleZh: 請考慮加入我們的新專案團隊。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-postpone
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: They **postponed** *releasing* the quarterly report.
exampleZh: 他們延後發布季度報告。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-recommend
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: I **recommend** *booking* the flight early.
exampleZh: 我建議提早訂機票。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-finish
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: She **finished** *drafting* the proposal this morning.
exampleZh: 她今天早上寫完了提案草稿。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-mind
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: Would you **mind** *closing* the window?
exampleZh: 可以麻煩你把窗戶關上嗎？

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-look-forward-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: We **look forward to** *working* with you.
exampleZh: 我們期待與您合作。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-be-used-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: He **is used to** *waking* up early.
exampleZh: 他習慣早起。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-be-committed-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: The firm **is committed to** *reducing* waste.
exampleZh: 這家公司致力於減少廢棄物。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-object-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: Several employees **object to** *changing* the schedule.
exampleZh: 好幾位員工反對更動班表。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-be-worth
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: The seminar **is worth** *attending*.
exampleZh: 這場研討會值得參加。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-networking
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: **Networking** *is* essential for career growth.
exampleZh: 建立人脈對職涯發展至關重要。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞#v-budgeting
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/02_動名詞
example: **Budgeting** *requires* careful planning.
exampleZh: 編列預算需要縝密的規劃。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句#v-leading
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句
example: **Leading** companies invest heavily in R&D.
exampleZh: 頂尖企業在研發上投入巨資。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句#v-remaining
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句
example: Please review the **remaining** issues before the deadline.
exampleZh: 請在期限前檢視剩下的問題。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句#v-rising
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句
example: The **rising** cost of materials affects our margin.
exampleZh: 原物料成本上漲影響了我們的利潤率。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句#v-attached
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句
example: Please see the **attached** file for details.
exampleZh: 詳情請見附件檔案。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句#v-enclosed
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句
example: The **enclosed** brochure explains our services.
exampleZh: 隨附的手冊說明了我們的服務內容。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句#v-qualified
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句
example: We are looking for **qualified** candidates.
exampleZh: 我們正在尋找符合資格的人選。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句#v-detailed
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句
example: A **detailed** report will be sent next week.
exampleZh: 下週會寄出一份詳細的報告。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句#v-regarding
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句
example: **Regarding** your request, we need more information.
exampleZh: 關於您的要求，我們需要更多資訊。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句#v-given-(that)
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句
example: **Given** the current budget, we must cut costs.
exampleZh: 考量目前的預算，我們必須刪減開支。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句#v-provided-(that)
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句
example: You may proceed **provided that** you have approval.
exampleZh: 只要你取得核准，就可以繼續進行。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句#v-considering
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/03_分詞與分詞構句
example: **Considering** the weather, the event may be delayed.
exampleZh: 考慮到天候狀況，活動可能會延期。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞#v-bore
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞
example: boring/bored | The lecture was so **boring** that many students fell asleep.
exampleZh: 這堂課無聊到很多學生都睡著了。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞#v-tire
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞
example: tiring/tired | After a **tiring** day, she went straight to bed.
exampleZh: 忙了累人的一天後，她倒頭就睡。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞#v-amaze
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞
example: amazing/amazed | We were **amazed** *at* the results of the survey.
exampleZh: 這份問卷的結果讓我們大為驚訝。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞#v-frustrate
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞
example: frustrating/frustrated | The delay was extremely **frustrating** for the customers.
exampleZh: 這次延誤讓顧客非常沮喪。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞#v-motivate
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞
example: motivating/motivated | The bonus scheme is highly **motivating** for the sales team.
exampleZh: 這套獎金制度對業務團隊非常有激勵作用。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞#v-overwhelm
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞
example: overwhelming/overwhelmed | She felt **overwhelmed** *by* the amount of work.
exampleZh: 龐大的工作量讓她應接不暇。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞#v-fascinate
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞
example: fascinating/fascinated | The museum exhibit was truly **fascinating**.
exampleZh: 這個博物館的展覽真的很吸引人。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞#v-be-interested-in
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞
example: He **is interested in** *pursuing* a career in finance.
exampleZh: 他有興趣往金融業發展。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞#v-be-satisfied-with
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞
example: The client **is satisfied with** the final design.
exampleZh: 客戶對最終設計感到滿意。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞#v-be-worried-about
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞
example: Employees **are worried about** the upcoming layoffs.
exampleZh: 員工們擔心即將到來的裁員。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞#v-be-excited-about
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/04_情緒動詞與分詞
example: The team **is excited about** the new product launch.
exampleZh: 團隊對新產品上市感到興奮。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型#v-claim
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型
example: He **claims to have completed** the certification last year.
exampleZh: 他聲稱去年已經取得這張證照。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型#v-seem
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型
example: The data **seems to have been** miscalculated.
exampleZh: 這筆數據似乎算錯了。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型#v-regret
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型
example: We **regret to inform** you of the delay.
exampleZh: 我們遺憾地通知您延誤一事。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型#v-acknowledge
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型
example: She **acknowledged having made** an error in the report.
exampleZh: 她承認自己在報告裡出了錯。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型#v-carry
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型
example: He entered **with** a folder **carrying** important documents.
exampleZh: 他拿著一個裝有重要文件的資料夾走進來。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型#v-verify
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型
example: The invoice was approved **with** all figures **verified**.
exampleZh: 這張發票在所有數字都經過核對後獲得核准。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型#v-attach
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型
example: She sent the email **with** a file **attached**.
exampleZh: 她寄出那封附有檔案的電子郵件。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型#v-without-+-v-ing
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型
example: You cannot enter the lab **without** *wearing* proper gear.
exampleZh: 沒有穿戴適當裝備就不能進入實驗室。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型#v-be-worthy-of-+-v-ing/n
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型
example: This achievement **is worthy of** *recognition*.
exampleZh: 這項成就值得表揚。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型#v-being-p.p.
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/05_動狀詞補充句型
example: She disliked **being interrupted** during presentations.
exampleZh: 她不喜歡簡報時被打斷。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-finalize
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: The team needs one more day **to finalize** the budget proposal.
exampleZh: 團隊還需要一天時間來完成預算提案。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-notify
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: It is essential for the supervisor **to notify** all staff of the change.
exampleZh: 主管必須將變更通知所有員工。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-secure
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: Our goal is **to secure** a long-term contract with the supplier.
exampleZh: 我們的目標是與供應商簽訂長期合約。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-escalate
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: Any unresolved complaint should be **escalated to** the regional director.
exampleZh: 任何未解決的投訴應上報給區域總監。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-stagger
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: Managers decided **to stagger** shifts in order to reduce congestion in the break room.
exampleZh: 經理決定錯開輪班，以減少休息室的擁擠情況。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-outsource
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: The firm plans **to outsource** its data entry tasks next quarter.
exampleZh: 該公司計劃下個季度外包其資料輸入任務。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-streamline
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: The new software was designed **to streamline** the approval process.
exampleZh: 新軟體旨在簡化審批流程。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-withhold
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: The finance office chose **to withhold** payment until the invoice was corrected.
exampleZh: 財務辦公室選擇扣留付款，直到發票更正為止。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-thoughtful
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: It was **thoughtful of** the director *to acknowledge* every team member.
exampleZh: 導演對每個團隊成員的認可都非常周到。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-considerate
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: It was **considerate of** her *to reschedule* the call for overseas clients.
exampleZh: 她為海外客戶重新安排了通話時間，真是太體貼了。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-wise
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
meaning: 明智的（評價事或人皆可）
example: It would be **wise for** the firm *to diversify* its suppliers.
exampleZh: 對該公司來說，使其供應商多元化是明智之舉。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-prudent
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: It is **prudent for** managers *to review* every contract clause carefully.
exampleZh: 管理者應謹慎地仔細審查每一項合約條款。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-feasible
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: It is not **feasible for** the team *to finish* the audit by Friday.
exampleZh: 該團隊在周五之前完成審核是不可能的。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-vital
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: It is **vital for** every employee *to understand* the safety procedures.
exampleZh: 對於每位員工來說，了解安全程序至關重要。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-inconsiderate
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: It was **inconsiderate of** him *to cancel* the meeting without notice.
exampleZh: 他未經通知就取消會議，實在太不體貼了。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-relieved
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: The auditor was **relieved to** *find* no discrepancies in the accounts.
exampleZh: 審計員發現帳目沒有任何差異，鬆了一口氣。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-astonished
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: Investors were **astonished to** *hear* about the sudden merger.
exampleZh: 投資者對突然的合併感到驚訝。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-reluctant
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: The supplier was **reluctant to** *lower* its prices further.
exampleZh: 供應商不願進一步降低價格。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-content
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: The client seemed **content to** *wait* for the revised proposal.
exampleZh: 客戶似乎滿足於等待修改後的提案。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-anxious
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: The intern was **anxious to** *make* a good impression during her first week.
exampleZh: 實習生渴望在第一週給人留下好印象。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-only-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: The courier arrived early, **only to find** the office still closed.
exampleZh: 快遞員提前到達，卻發現辦公室還關上門。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-such...as-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: The backlog was **such** a burden **as to** *delay* every downstream department.
exampleZh: 積壓的訂單是一個沉重的負擔，以至於耽誤了下游各部門的工作。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-so-as-not-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: The clerk verified the total twice **so as not to** *overcharge* the customer.
exampleZh: 店員核對了兩次總數，以免多收顧客費用。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-in-order-not-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: The firm postponed the launch **in order not to** *clash* with a competitor's event.
exampleZh: 該公司推遲了發布會，以免與競爭對手的活動發生衝突。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-be-reluctant-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: The vendor was **reluctant to** extend the payment deadline.
exampleZh: 賣方不願意延長付款期限。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-be-entitled-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
example: Full-time staff **are entitled to** *request* additional leave.
exampleZh: 全職員工有權申請額外休假。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階#v-it-is-up-to-sb-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/06_不定詞三大功能進階
word: it is up to sb to V
example: **It is up to** the finance director **to** *approve* the extra spending.
exampleZh: 額外支出由財務長批准。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-file
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: *Filing* the expense report accurately *saves* the accounting team time.
exampleZh: 準確提交費用報告可以節省會計團隊的時間。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-coordinate
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: *Coordinating* three departments *requires* constant communication.
exampleZh: 協調三個部門需要不斷溝通。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-audit
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: *Auditing* every invoice manually *is* no longer practical.
exampleZh: 手動審核每張發票已不再實用。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-renegotiate
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: *Renegotiating* the lease *helped* the company save 10 percent annually.
exampleZh: 重新談判租約幫助該公司每年節省 10%。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-flag
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: *Flagging* irregular transactions *is* the compliance officer's daily task.
exampleZh: 標記違規交易是合規官的日常任務。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-in-addition-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: *In addition to* reviewing contracts, the lawyer also drafts new clauses.
exampleZh: 除了審查合約外，律師還起草新條款。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-when-it-comes-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: *When it comes to* pricing strategy, the CFO has final say.
exampleZh: 在定價策略方面，財務長擁有最終決定權。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-in-favor-of
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: Most shareholders voted *in favor of* merging the two divisions.
exampleZh: 大多數股東投票贊成合併兩個部門。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-as-for
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: *As for* extending the deadline, the director remains undecided.
exampleZh: 至於延長期限，導演尚未決定。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-get-around-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: The manager finally *got around to* updating the employee handbook.
exampleZh: 經理終於抽出時間來更新員工手冊。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-look-into
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: The committee agreed to *look into* streamlining the approval process.
exampleZh: 委員會同意研究簡化審批流程。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-count-on
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: The department *counts on* receiving the report before Friday.
exampleZh: 該部門希望在周五之前收到報告。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-rely-on
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: The plant *relies on* recycling materials to cut waste.
exampleZh: 該工廠依靠回收材料來減少浪費。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-focus-on
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: The new hire should *focus on* mastering the booking system first.
exampleZh: 新員工首先應該專注於掌握預訂系統。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-succeed-in
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: The negotiator *succeeded in* lowering the shipping fee.
exampleZh: 談判者成功地降低了運費。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-engage-in
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: Employees are prohibited from *engaging in* soliciting clients for personal gain.
exampleZh: 禁止員工為謀取私利而招攬客戶。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-specialize-in
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: The firm *specializes in* auditing small manufacturing businesses.
exampleZh: 該公司專門從事小型製造企業的審計。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-excel-at
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: The candidate *excels at* resolving customer disputes quickly.
exampleZh: 該候選人擅長快速解決客戶糾紛。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-keen-on
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: The regional manager is *keen on* expanding into overseas markets.
exampleZh: 區域經理熱衷於拓展海外市場。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-fond-of
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: The design lead is *fond of* experimenting with new packaging.
exampleZh: 設計主管喜歡嘗試新包裝。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-tired-of
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: Several staff members are *tired of* repeating the same onboarding steps.
exampleZh: 有些員工厭倦了重複相同的入職步驟。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-proud-of
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: The director is *proud of* mentoring junior analysts.
exampleZh: 主管為指導初級分析師而感到自豪。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-devoted-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: The nonprofit is *devoted to* improving supply chain transparency.
exampleZh: 該非營利組織致力於提高供應鏈透明度。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-prone-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: Outdated machines are *prone to* causing production delays.
exampleZh: 過時的機器很容易導致生產延誤。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-opposed-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: Some managers are *opposed to* adopting the new scheduling software.
exampleZh: 一些經理反對採用新的調度軟體。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-resort-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: The vendor had to *resort to* offering discounts to clear inventory.
exampleZh: 供應商不得不訴諸提供折扣來清理庫存。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-adapt-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: New employees must *adapt to* working under tight deadlines.
exampleZh: 新員工必須適應在緊迫的期限內工作。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-participate-in
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: All branch managers are expected to *participate in* reviewing the annual budget.
exampleZh: 所有分行經理應參與年度預算的審查。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-take-pride-in
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: The workshop *takes pride in* delivering custom orders on time.
exampleZh: 該車間以按時交付客製化訂單而感到自豪。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-cannot-help-but
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: The reviewer *could* not *help but* praise the clarity of the report.
exampleZh: 審稿者忍不住稱讚報告的清晰度。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞#v-far-from
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/07_動名詞當主詞與介系詞後動名詞
example: The onboarding process is *far from* being finished.
exampleZh: 入職流程還遠遠未完成。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-remember
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: Please **remember to** *submit* the timesheet before Friday.
exampleZh: 請記住在周五之前提交時間表。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-forget
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: He will never **forget** *closing* the biggest deal of his career.
exampleZh: 他永遠不會忘記完成他職業生涯中最大的一筆交易。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-regret
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: We **regret to** *announce* that the branch will be closed permanently.
exampleZh: 我們很遺憾地宣布，該分行將永久關閉。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-stop
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: The supplier **stopped** *shipping* products without prior notice.
exampleZh: 供應商停止運送產品，恕不另行通知。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-try
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: Employees should **try** *contacting* the help desk before escalating the issue.
exampleZh: 員工應在升級問題之前嘗試聯絡服務台。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-mean
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: Cutting the budget would **mean** *reducing* the marketing headcount.
exampleZh: 削減預算意味著減少行銷人員數量。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-quit
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: The board **quit** *funding* the unprofitable division.
exampleZh: 董事會停止為無利可圖的部門提供資金。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-deserve
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: The proposal **deserves** *further discussion* at the next meeting.
exampleZh: 該提案值得在下次會議上進一步討論。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-attempt
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: The technician **attempted to** *reboot* the system twice before calling support.
exampleZh: 在致電支援之前，技術人員嘗試重新啟動系統兩次。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-cease
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: The manufacturer will **cease** *producing* the older model by year end.
exampleZh: 製造商將在年底前停止生產舊型號。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-recall
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: She could not **recall** *meeting* the client at last year's expo.
exampleZh: 她不記得在去年的博覽會上見過這位客戶。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-imagine
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: It is hard to **imagine** *running* the logistics center without the new software.
exampleZh: 很難想像在沒有新軟體的情況下營運物流中心。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-appreciate
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: We would **appreciate** *receiving* your feedback by Monday.
exampleZh: 我們很高興在周一之前收到您的回饋。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-delay
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: The vendor **delayed** *delivering* the parts due to a customs inspection.
exampleZh: 由於海關檢查，供應商延遲交付零件。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-resist
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: The negotiator could barely **resist** *accepting* the counteroffer immediately.
exampleZh: 談判代表忍不住立即接受了還價。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-tolerate
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: The firm will not **tolerate** *falsifying* expense reports.
exampleZh: 公司不會容忍偽造費用報告。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-discontinue
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: The retailer **discontinued** *stocking* the seasonal item after low sales.
exampleZh: 在銷售低迷後，零售商停止了季節性商品的庫存。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-undertake
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: The consultancy **undertook to** *restructure* the entire supply chain.
exampleZh: 該諮詢公司致力於重組整個供應鏈。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-request
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: Clients frequently **request** *rescheduling* their appointments at short notice.
exampleZh: 客戶經常要求在短時間內重新安排預約。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-dread
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: Many staff **dread** *presenting* figures to senior executives.
exampleZh: 許多員工害怕向高階主管展示數據。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-risk
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: The company would **risk** *losing* its reputation by ignoring the complaint.
exampleZh: 如果忽視投訴，該公司將面臨失去聲譽的風險。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-practice
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: New agents **practice** *handling* difficult customer calls during training.
exampleZh: 新代理在培訓期間練習處理棘手的客戶電話。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-can't-help-+-v-ing
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: The interviewer **couldn't help smiling** at the candidate's confident answer.
exampleZh: 看到應徵者自信的回答，面試官不禁笑了。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-used-to-+-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
meaning: 過去習慣（現在已非如此）
example: The department **used to submit** paper forms before the system was digitized.
exampleZh: 在系統數位化之前，該部門過去常常提交紙本表格。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞#v-get-used-to-+-v-ing
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/08_不定詞動名詞意義差異動詞
example: It took the new hires weeks to **get used to using** the inventory system.
exampleZh: 新員工花了幾週才習慣使用庫存系統。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-absent
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: The manager was **absent** from the meeting due to a scheduling conflict.
exampleZh: 由於時間衝突，經理缺席了會議。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-henceforth
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: **Henceforth**, all expense reports must be submitted electronically.
exampleZh: 從今以後，所有費用報告都必須以電子方式提交。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-albeit
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: The plan succeeded, **albeit** with a few unexpected setbacks.
exampleZh: 儘管遇到了一些意想不到的挫折，但該計劃成功了。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-postponement
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: The client requested a **postponement** of the contract signing.
exampleZh: 客戶要求延後簽訂合約。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-absence
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: The supervisor's **absence** delayed the approval process.
exampleZh: 主管缺席，導致審批流程延誤。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-shortage
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: A staff **shortage** forced the warehouse to reduce operating hours.
exampleZh: 人員短缺迫使倉庫縮短了營業時間。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-constraint
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: Budget **constraints** prevented the department from hiring additional staff.
exampleZh: 預算限制使該部門無法僱用更多員工。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-workload
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: The new system was designed to reduce the team's **workload**.
exampleZh: 新系統旨在減少團隊的工作量。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-resource
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: The project requires more financial **resources** than originally planned.
exampleZh: 該項目需要比原計劃更多的財政資源。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-approval
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: The proposal is still awaiting final **approval** from the board.
exampleZh: 該提案仍在等待董事會的最終批准。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-weather-permitting
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: **Weather permitting**, the site inspection will take place outdoors.
exampleZh: 如果天氣允許，現場檢查將在室外進行。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-time-permitting
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: **Time permitting**, we will also cover next quarter's targets.
exampleZh: 如果時間允許，我們還將討論下個季度的目標。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-budget-permitting
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: **Budget permitting**, the firm plans to open a second branch office.
exampleZh: 如果預算允許，該公司計劃開設第二家分公司。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-schedule-permitting
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: **Schedule permitting**, the director will join the site visit in person.
exampleZh: 如果時間允許，主任將親自參加現場考察。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-all-things-considered
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: **All things considered**, the merger still appears financially sound.
exampleZh: 考慮到所有因素，這次合併在財務上似乎仍然健全。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-everything-considered
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: **Everything considered**, the vendor's proposal offers the best value.
exampleZh: 綜合考慮，供應商的建議提供了最佳價值。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-that-being-said
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: The results were disappointing; **that being said**, the team learned valuable lessons.
exampleZh: 結果令人失望；話雖如此，團隊還是學到了寶貴的經驗教訓。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-having-said-that
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: **Having said that**, management still supports the expansion plan.
exampleZh: 話雖如此，管理層仍然支持擴張計劃。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-all-being-well
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: **All being well**, the new branch will open by early next year.
exampleZh: 如果一切順利，新分行將於明年初開幕。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-other-things-being-equal
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
meaning: 在其他條件相同的情況下
example: **Other things being equal**, the committee prefers the local supplier.
exampleZh: 在其他條件相同的情況下，委員會更傾向於選擇當地供應商。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-generally-speaking
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: **Generally speaking**, quarterly reports are due within five business days.
exampleZh: 一般來說，季度報告應在五個工作天內提交。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句#v-strictly-speaking
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/09_獨立分詞構句
example: **Strictly speaking**, the contract does not cover overtime compensation.
exampleZh: 嚴格來說，合約中不包括加班費。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-concerned-about
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: Senior management **is concerned about** the *rising* cost of raw materials.
exampleZh: 高階管理層對原材料成本上漲感到擔憂。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-dedicated-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The customer support team **is dedicated to** *resolving* complaints within 24 hours.
exampleZh: 客戶支援團隊致力於在 24 小時內解決投訴。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-devoted-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The foundation **is devoted to** improving working conditions in the factory.
exampleZh: 該基金會致力於改善工廠的工作條件。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-geared-toward
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: This training program **is geared toward** first-time managers.
exampleZh: 該培訓計劃面向新任經理。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-affiliated-with
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The consulting firm **is affiliated with** several major accounting networks.
exampleZh: 該諮詢公司隸屬於幾個主要的會計網絡。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-inclined-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The board **is inclined to** approve the expansion plan next quarter.
exampleZh: 董事會傾向於批准下個季度的擴張計劃。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-accustomed-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: Veteran staff **are accustomed to** working under tight deadlines.
exampleZh: 經驗豐富的員工習慣在緊迫的期限內工作。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-attached-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: Please note that a revised invoice **is attached to** this email.
exampleZh: 請注意，此電子郵件附有修訂後的發票。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-tailored-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The proposal **was tailored to** the client's specific budget constraints.
exampleZh: 該提案是根據客戶的具體預算限制量身定制的。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-oriented-toward
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The new curriculum **is oriented toward** practical, hands-on skills.
exampleZh: 新課程著重實踐、動手技能。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-rooted-in
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The company's conservative pricing strategy **is rooted in** its early struggles during the recession.
exampleZh: 該公司保守的定價策略源自於早期在經濟衰退期間的困境。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-grounded-in
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: Every recommendation in the report **is grounded in** verifiable market data.
exampleZh: 報告中的每項建議均基於可驗證的市場數據。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-confined-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: Access to the server room **is confined to** authorized IT personnel.
exampleZh: 只有經過授權的 IT 人員才能進入伺服器機房。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-restricted-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: Parking on the ground floor **is restricted to** executives and visiting clients.
exampleZh: 一樓的停車位僅限高階主管和來訪客戶使用。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-limited-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The warranty **is limited to** manufacturing defects only.
exampleZh: 保固僅限於製造缺陷。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-bound-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: Without additional funding, the project **is bound to** fall behind schedule.
exampleZh: 如果沒有額外的資金，該項目必然會落後於計劃。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-tied-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: Employee bonuses **are tied to** individual performance reviews.
exampleZh: 員工獎金與個人績效考核掛鉤。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-linked-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The delivery delay **was linked to** a shortage of shipping containers.
exampleZh: 交貨延誤與貨櫃短缺有關。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-associated-with
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: High turnover **is often associated with** poor management practices.
exampleZh: 高流動率通常與不良的管理實務有關。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-involved-in
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: Three departments **are directly involved in** the product launch.
exampleZh: 三個部門直接參與產品發布。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-engaged-in
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The legal team **is currently engaged in** contract negotiations.
exampleZh: 法律團隊目前正在進行合約談判。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-absorbed-in
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The analyst **was so absorbed in** the spreadsheet that she missed the meeting reminder.
exampleZh: 這位分析師太​​專注於電子表格，以至於錯過了會議提醒。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-preoccupied-with
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: Executives **are preoccupied with** the upcoming merger announcement.
exampleZh: 高層全神貫注於即將發布的合併公告。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-convinced-of
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The investors **are convinced of** the product's long-term profitability.
exampleZh: 投資者對該產品的長期獲利能力深信不疑。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-poised-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The startup **is poised to** enter the European market next year.
exampleZh: 該新創公司準備在明年進入歐洲市場。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-positioned-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The firm **is well positioned to** benefit from the new trade agreement.
exampleZh: 該公司處於有利地位，可以從新的貿易協定中受益。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-slated-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The renovation **is slated to** begin in early September.
exampleZh: 翻修工程預計於九月初開始。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-destined-to
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: Analysts believe the merger **is destined to** reshape the industry.
exampleZh: 分析家認為，此次合併注定會重塑該產業。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-plagued-by
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The rollout **was plagued by** technical glitches during its first week.
exampleZh: 推出的第一週就受到技術故障的困擾。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配#v-be-steeped-in
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/10_過去分詞形容詞固定搭配
example: The firm's culture **is steeped in** tradition, which sometimes slows decision-making.
exampleZh: 該公司的文化根深蒂固，有時會減慢決策速度。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-allegedly
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The manager **allegedly** authorized the payment without approval.
exampleZh: 據稱，經理未經批准就授權付款。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-purportedly
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The document was **purportedly** signed by the former director.
exampleZh: 據稱該文件是由前董事簽署的。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-supposedly
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The missing shipment was **supposedly** lost in transit.
exampleZh: 失蹤的貨物據稱是在運輸途中遺失的。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-rumored
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The company is **rumored** to have been in merger talks.
exampleZh: 據傳該公司正在進行合併談判。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-documented
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The firm's growth is well **documented** to have started five years ago.
exampleZh: 有據可查的是，該公司的發展始於五年前。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-inspect
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: Every shipment must be scheduled to be **inspected** upon arrival.
exampleZh: 每批貨物必須安排在抵達時接受檢查。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-sanction
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The expansion plan is expected to be **sanctioned** by the board.
exampleZh: 該擴張計劃預計將獲得董事會批准。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-refund
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: Deposits are supposed to be **refunded** within two weeks of cancellation.
exampleZh: 押金應在取消後兩週內退還。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-relocate
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The headquarters is scheduled to be **relocated** next spring.
exampleZh: 總部計劃於明年春天搬遷。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-indemnify
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: Affected customers are expected to be **indemnified** for the inconvenience.
exampleZh: 受影響的客戶預計將獲得不便的賠償。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-overhaul
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The outdated system needs to be **overhauled** before the merger.
exampleZh: 合併前需要對過時的系統進行徹底檢修。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-accomplish
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The team is proud to **have accomplished** the target ahead of schedule.
exampleZh: 該團隊為提前完成目標感到自豪。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-outpace
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The department claims to **have outpaced** its quarterly quota.
exampleZh: 該部門聲稱已經超出了季度配額。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-overlook
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The reviewer seems to **have overlooked** a key clause in the contract.
exampleZh: 審查者似乎忽略了合約中的一個關鍵條款。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-underestimate
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The manager admitted to **have underestimated** the project's complexity.
exampleZh: 經理承認低估了專案的複雜性。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-withdraw
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The bidder is said to **have withdrawn** its offer at the last minute.
exampleZh: 據說競標者在最後一刻撤回了報價。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-be-said-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The vendor **is said to have** raised its prices last quarter.
exampleZh: 據說該供應商上季度提高了價格。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-be-believed-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The delay **is believed to have been** caused by a software glitch.
exampleZh: 據信，延遲是由軟體故障造成的。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-be-thought-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The proposal **is thought to have been** rejected by the board.
exampleZh: 據信該提議已被董事會拒絕。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-be-poised-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The audit **is poised to be** completed by Friday.
exampleZh: 審計預計將於週五完成。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-be-expected-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: Staff **are expected to be** briefed before the site visit.
exampleZh: 預計工作人員將在實地考察前聽取簡報。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-be-liable-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: Long-term employees **are liable to be** reimbursed for relocation costs.
exampleZh: 長期僱員有責任報銷搬遷費用。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-be-due-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The contract **is due to be** renewed next month.
exampleZh: 合約將於下個月續約。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-be-reported-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The factory **is reported to have** resumed operations.
exampleZh: 據報道，該工廠已恢復運作。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式#v-turn-out-to-v
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/11_不定詞完成式與被動式
example: The invoice **turned out to have been** duplicated by mistake.
exampleZh: 結果發票被錯誤地重複了。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-negate
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The new evidence did not *negate* the original agreement between the two firms.
exampleZh: 新的證據並沒有否定兩家公司之間最初的協議。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-negation
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The clause's *negation* clearly excludes part-time staff from the bonus program.
exampleZh: 該條款的否定明確地將兼職員工排除在獎金計劃之外。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-refrain
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: Employees are asked to *refrain* from using personal devices during client meetings.
exampleZh: 要求員工在客戶會議期間不要使用個人設備。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-abstain
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: Two board members chose to *abstain* from voting on the merger proposal.
exampleZh: 兩名董事會成員選擇對合併提案放棄投票。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-decline
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The vendor politely *declined* to lower the price further.
exampleZh: 供應商禮貌地拒絕進一步降低價格。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-omit
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: Please do not *omit* any required field on the reimbursement form.
exampleZh: 請不要遺漏報銷表上的任何必填欄位。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-exclude
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The policy explicitly *excludes* interns from the profit-sharing plan.
exampleZh: 該政策明確將實習生排除在利潤分享計畫之外。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-prohibit
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: Company rules *prohibit* staff from disclosing client information externally.
exampleZh: 公司規定禁止員工對外揭露客戶資訊。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-restrain
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The manager had to *restrain* himself from interrupting the presentation.
exampleZh: 經理不得不克制自己不要打斷演示。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-discourage
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The steep fee is meant to *discourage* customers from canceling last minute.
exampleZh: 高昂的費用是為了阻止顧客在最後一刻取消預訂。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-hesitant
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The board remained *hesitant* about not renewing the current supplier's contract.
exampleZh: 董事會對於是否與現有供應商續約仍猶豫不決。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-reluctantly
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The director *reluctantly* agreed not to expand the department this year.
exampleZh: 主任無奈同意今年不擴大部門規模。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-thoroughly
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The auditor *thoroughly* examined every invoice before signing off.
exampleZh: 審計員在簽字前徹底檢查了每張發票。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-diligently
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The new analyst worked *diligently* to finish the forecast ahead of schedule.
exampleZh: 新來的分析師勤奮工作，提前完成了預測。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-cautiously
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The CFO proceeded *cautiously* before approving the overseas investment.
exampleZh: 財務長在批准海外投資之前謹慎行事。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-explicitly
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The contract *explicitly* states that late deliveries will incur a penalty.
exampleZh: 合約明確規定，逾期交貨將受到處罰。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-deliberately
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The negotiator *deliberately* paused before presenting the counteroffer.
exampleZh: 談判者在提出還價之前故意停頓了一下。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-inadvertently
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The clerk *inadvertently* omitted a required signature on the form.
exampleZh: 辦事員無意中遺漏了表格上所需的簽名。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-repeatedly
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The supplier *repeatedly* failed to meet the agreed delivery schedule.
exampleZh: 供應商多次未能滿足約定的交貨時間表。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-rigorously
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: All applicants are *rigorously* screened before receiving a job offer.
exampleZh: 所有申請人在收到工作機會之前都會經過嚴格篩選。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-consciously
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: Managers were asked to *consciously* avoid favoring any single vendor.
exampleZh: 管理人員被要求有意識地避免偏袒任何單一供應商。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-fully
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The team has not *fully* addressed the client's concerns yet.
exampleZh: 該團隊尚未完全解決客戶的擔憂。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-barely
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The department *barely* managed to meet the quarterly quota.
exampleZh: 該部門勉強完成了季度指標。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-strictly
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: Visitors are *strictly* prohibited from entering the server room unaccompanied.
exampleZh: 嚴禁訪客無人陪同進入伺服器機房。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-unintentionally
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The assistant *unintentionally* sent the confidential memo to the wrong list.
exampleZh: 助理無意中將機密備忘錄發送到了錯誤的清單。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-outright
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The board *outright* rejected the proposal to relocate headquarters.
exampleZh: 董事會斷然拒絕了總部搬遷的提議。

id: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置#v-flatly
chapterId: grammar/03_動狀詞_非謂語動詞/12_動狀詞否定與副詞修飾位置
example: The supplier *flatly* refused not to raise prices next quarter.
exampleZh: 供應商斷然拒絕下季不再漲價。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞#v-compel
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞
example: The new regulation **compelled** the company to change its policy.
exampleZh: 這項新法規迫使公司修改政策。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞#v-force
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞
example: They were **forced** to relocate the factory.
exampleZh: 他們被迫將工廠遷址。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞#v-oblige
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞
example: The contract **obliges** both parties to comply with the terms.
exampleZh: 這份合約使雙方都必須遵守條款。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞#v-permit
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞
example: The manager **permitted** staff to leave early on Friday.
exampleZh: 經理准許員工週五提早下班。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞#v-allow
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞
example: The policy **allows** employees to work remotely.
exampleZh: 這項政策允許員工遠端工作。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞#v-enable
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞
example: This software **enables** users to track expenses easily.
exampleZh: 這套軟體讓使用者能輕鬆追蹤支出。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞#v-assist
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞
example: The consultant **assisted** the team in preparing the report.
exampleZh: 顧問協助團隊撰寫這份報告。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞#v-instruct
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/01_使役動詞
example: She **instructed** her assistant to file the documents.
exampleZh: 她吩咐助理把文件歸檔。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞#v-observe
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞
example: Auditors **observed** the staff following the new procedure.
exampleZh: 稽核人員觀察到員工確實依照新流程作業。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞#v-spot
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞
example: She **spotted** an error in the invoice.
exampleZh: 她發現發票上有個錯誤。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞#v-glimpse
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞
example: He **glimpsed** the manager leaving the building.
exampleZh: 他瞥見經理走出大樓。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞#v-overhear
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞
example: I **overheard** them discussing the merger.
exampleZh: 我無意間聽到他們在討論併購案。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞#v-perceive
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞
example: Customers **perceived** the new packaging as more eco-friendly.
exampleZh: 顧客認為新包裝更環保。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞#v-sense
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞
example: The manager **sensed** tension among the team members.
exampleZh: 經理察覺到團隊成員之間的緊張氣氛。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞#v-notice
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/02_感官動詞
example: Nobody **noticed** the printer running out of paper.
exampleZh: 沒有人注意到印表機的紙用完了。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞#v-insist
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: The client **insisted** that the order be delivered by Friday.
exampleZh: 客戶堅持這筆訂單要在週五前送達。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞#v-demand
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: The union **demanded** that management raise wages.
exampleZh: 工會要求資方調漲薪資。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞#v-require
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: The law **requires** that all drivers carry insurance.
exampleZh: 法律規定所有駕駛人都必須投保。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞#v-command
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: The general **commanded** that the troops withdraw immediately.
exampleZh: 將軍下令部隊立即撤退。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞#v-suggest
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: The doctor **suggested** that she rest for a week.
exampleZh: 醫生建議她休息一週。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞#v-recommend
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: We **recommend** that applicants submit their forms early.
exampleZh: 我們建議申請人及早遞交表格。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞#v-propose
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: He **proposed** that the meeting be rescheduled.
exampleZh: 他提議把會議改期。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞#v-urge
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: The manager **urged** that the team finish the project on time.
exampleZh: 經理力促團隊準時完成專案。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞#v-advise
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: The consultant **advised** that the company invest in training.
exampleZh: 顧問建議公司投資教育訓練。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞#v-imperative
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: It is **imperative** that the issue be resolved today.
exampleZh: 這個問題今天務必要解決。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞#v-advisable
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: It is **advisable** that new staff attend orientation.
exampleZh: 新進員工最好參加職前訓練。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞#v-requirement
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: The **requirement** that all staff wear badges is strictly enforced.
exampleZh: 全體員工配戴識別證的規定執行得很嚴格。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞#v-recommendation
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/03_意志動詞與建議動詞
example: Her **recommendation** that the budget be increased was approved.
exampleZh: 她提出的增加預算建議獲得採納。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-require
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: The job **requires** applicants to have three years of experience.
exampleZh: 這份工作要求應徵者具備三年經驗。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-expect
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: We **expect** the shipment to arrive by Monday.
exampleZh: 我們預計貨物會在週一前送達。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-need
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: The team **needs** everyone to cooperate on this project.
exampleZh: 這個專案需要每個人一起配合。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-allow
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: The new software **allows** users to customize their dashboard.
exampleZh: 這套新軟體讓使用者可以自訂儀表板。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-enable
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: This grant **enables** small businesses to expand overseas.
exampleZh: 這筆補助讓小型企業得以拓展海外市場。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-permit
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: The manager **permitted** the intern to leave early.
exampleZh: 經理准許實習生提早離開。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-remind
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: The system will **remind** users to update their passwords.
exampleZh: 系統會提醒使用者更新密碼。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-warn
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: The sign **warns** pedestrians to watch for traffic.
exampleZh: 這個標誌提醒行人注意來車。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-advise
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: The lawyer **advised** the client to sign the agreement.
exampleZh: 律師建議客戶簽署這份協議。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-instruct
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: The manual **instructs** technicians to check the voltage first.
exampleZh: 這本手冊指示技師先檢查電壓。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-persuade
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: The salesperson **persuaded** the customer to upgrade the plan.
exampleZh: 業務員說服顧客升級方案。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-encourage
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: Managers are **encouraged** to give constructive feedback.
exampleZh: 公司鼓勵主管給予建設性的回饋。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞#v-invite
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/04_接受詞不定詞動詞
example: The organizer **invited** attendees to ask questions.
exampleZh: 主辦人邀請與會者提問。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-seem
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The offer *seemed* fair to everyone at the table.
exampleZh: 這個提議對桌上的每個人來說似乎都很公平。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-appear
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The figures *appear* accurate at first glance.
exampleZh: 乍一看，這些數字似乎很準確。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-look
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The renovated office *looks* impressive.
exampleZh: 裝修後的辦公室看起來令人印象深刻。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-sound
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The proposal *sounds* feasible.
exampleZh: 該提議聽起來可行。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-feel
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The workload *feels* unmanageable this quarter.
exampleZh: 本季的工作量感覺難以管理。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-taste
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: (常見於產品描述情境，非本課重點但同類動詞)
exampleZh: (於產品描述場景，非本課重點但同類動詞)

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-become
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The process *became* simpler after automation.
exampleZh: 自動化後，流程變得更簡單。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-turn
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The tone of the meeting *turned* hostile.
exampleZh: 會議的氣氛變得充滿敵意。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-grow
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: Client demands *grew* more specific over time.
exampleZh: 隨著時間的推移，客戶的需求變得更加具體。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-go
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The account *went* dormant after the client left.
exampleZh: 客戶離開後，該帳戶就處於休眠狀態。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-remain
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The budget *remained* unchanged despite inflation.
exampleZh: 儘管通貨膨脹，預算仍保持不變。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-stay
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: Team performance *stayed* consistent all year.
exampleZh: 團隊表現全年保持穩定。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-keep
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
meaning: 保持（常搭配現在分詞當補語）
example: The printer *keeps* jamming during rush hour.
exampleZh: 尖峰時段印表機總是卡紙。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-prove
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The strategy *proved* effective within a month.
exampleZh: 該策略在一個月內被證明是有效的。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-turn-out
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The candidate *turned out* highly qualified.
exampleZh: 結果證明這位候選人非常合格。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-reasonable
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The refund policy is *reasonable*.
exampleZh: 退款政策合理。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-convincing
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: Her argument *seemed* convincing.
exampleZh: 她的論點似乎很有說服力。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-plausible
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The excuse *sounded* plausible.
exampleZh: 這個藉口聽起來很有道理。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-stagnant
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: Sales *remained* stagnant for two quarters.
exampleZh: 銷售額連續兩季停滯不前。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-resilient
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The supply chain *proved* resilient during the shortage.
exampleZh: 事實證明，供應鏈在短缺期間具有彈性。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-volatile
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The stock price *turned* volatile after the announcement.
exampleZh: 消息公佈後，股價波動較大。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-lucrative
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The new territory *appeared* lucrative to investors.
exampleZh: 這個新領域對投資者來說似乎利潤豐厚。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-obsolete
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The equipment *became* obsolete within a few years.
exampleZh: 這些設備在幾年之內就變得過時了。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-redundant
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: Several positions *became* redundant after the merger.
exampleZh: 合併後，有些職位變得多餘。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-credible
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The witness *seemed* credible to the board.
exampleZh: 證人對董事會來說似乎是可信的。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-turbulent
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The industry *stayed* turbulent throughout the recession.
exampleZh: 在整個經濟衰退期間，該行業一直處於動盪狀態。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-viable
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The expansion plan *proved* viable after the pilot test.
exampleZh: 經過試點，該擴建計劃被證明是可行的。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-counterproductive
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The strict policy *turned out* counterproductive.
exampleZh: 嚴格的政策結果適得其反。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞#v-transparent
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/05_連綴動詞
example: The bidding process *remained* transparent throughout.
exampleZh: 招標過程自始至終保持透明。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞#v-offer
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞
example: The company will *offer* qualified candidates a signing bonus.
exampleZh: 公司將為合格的候選人提供簽約獎金。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞#v-buy
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞
example: The firm decided to *buy* its top performers new laptops.
exampleZh: 該公司決定為其表現最好的員工購買新筆記型電腦。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞#v-bring
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞
example: The intern was asked to *bring* the manager the signed contract.
exampleZh: 實習生被要求將已簽署的合約帶給經理。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞#v-teach
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞
example: The consultant will *teach* the interns effective negotiation skills.
exampleZh: 顧問將教授實習生有效的談判技巧。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞#v-pay
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞
example: The accounting department will *pay* the vendor the outstanding balance by Friday.
exampleZh: 會計部門將在周五之前向供應商支付未清餘額。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞#v-ask
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞
example: The auditor *asked* the finance team several pointed questions.
exampleZh: 審計員向財務團隊提出了幾個尖銳的問題。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞#v-cost
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞
example: The production delay *cost* the company a considerable amount of revenue.
exampleZh: 生產延誤使公司損失了大量收入。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞#v-issue
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞
example: The HR office will *issue* every new hire an identification badge.
exampleZh: 人力資源辦公室將為每位新進員工頒發身分識別卡。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞#v-mail
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞
example: Please *mail* the applicant a formal rejection letter within two weeks.
exampleZh: 請在兩週內向申請人郵寄正式拒絕信。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞#v-deliver
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞
example: The courier will *deliver* the office a fresh batch of supplies tomorrow.
exampleZh: 快遞員明天將向辦公室送去一批新的物資。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞#v-forward
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞
example: Could you *forward* me the client's original email?
exampleZh: 您能將客戶的原始電子郵件轉發給我嗎？

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞#v-wire
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞
example: The headquarters agreed to *wire* the branch office the remaining funds.
exampleZh: 總部同意將剩餘資金匯給分公司。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞#v-extend
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞
example: The bank chose to *extend* the small business a lower interest rate.
exampleZh: 銀行選擇向小型企業提供較低的利率。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞#v-allot
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞
example: The organizer will *allot* each speaker only fifteen minutes.
exampleZh: 主辦單位將為每位演講者分配十五分鐘的發言時間。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞#v-quote
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞
example: The supplier *quoted* the buyer an unusually competitive price.
exampleZh: 供應商向買方報出了異常有競爭力的價格。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞#v-charge
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/06_雙受詞動詞
example: The consulting firm *charges* clients an hourly rate for on-site visits.
exampleZh: 該諮詢公司按小時向客戶收取現場訪問費用。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-deal-with
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: The support team is trained to **deal with** difficult customers.
exampleZh: 支援團隊接受過處理困難客戶的訓練。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-cope-with
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: The warehouse struggled to **cope with** the surge in holiday orders.
exampleZh: 倉庫難以應對假期訂單的激增。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-attend-to
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: Please **attend to** the client's request as soon as possible.
exampleZh: 請盡快滿足客戶的要求。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-sort-out
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: The IT staff finally **sorted out** the login issue.
exampleZh: IT人員最終解決了登入問題。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-iron-out
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: The two firms met to **iron out** the remaining contract details.
exampleZh: 兩家公司會面敲定了剩餘的合約細節。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-set-up
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: The founder **set up** the company in 2015.
exampleZh: 創辦人於2015年成立公司。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-carry-out
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: The consultant was hired to **carry out** the market survey.
exampleZh: 聘請顧問進行市場調查。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-bring-about
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: The new policy **brought about** a sharp rise in productivity.
exampleZh: 新政策帶來了生產力的大幅提升。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-roll-out
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: The firm plans to **roll out** the update next quarter.
exampleZh: 該公司計劃在下個季度推出更新。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-carry-on
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: Despite the outage, the staff **carried on** with the meeting.
exampleZh: 儘管停電，工作人員仍繼續開會。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-come-up-with
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: The design team **came up with** a creative solution.
exampleZh: 設計團隊想出了一個創意的解決方案。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-put-forward
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: The board **put forward** a proposal to cut costs.
exampleZh: 董事會提出了削減成本的建議。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-draw-up
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: The lawyer was asked to **draw up** the contract.
exampleZh: 律師被要求起草合約。
