id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-work-out
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: The two sides finally **worked out** an agreement.
exampleZh: 雙方最終達成了協議。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-call-off
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: Organizers had to **call off** the outdoor event due to rain.
exampleZh: 由於下雨，主辦單位不得不取消戶外活動。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-put-off
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: The launch was **put off** until the supply issue was resolved.
exampleZh: 發射被推遲，直到供應問題解決。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-hold-off-on
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: Management decided to **hold off on** hiring until next quarter.
exampleZh: 管理層決定將招聘推遲到下個季度。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-phase-out
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: The manufacturer will **phase out** the older model by year-end.
exampleZh: 製造商將在年底前逐步淘汰舊型號。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-cut-back-on
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: The department was told to **cut back on** travel expenses.
exampleZh: 該部門被告知要削減差旅費用。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-scale-back
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: The firm decided to **scale back** its overseas operations.
exampleZh: 該公司決定縮減海外業務。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-take-over
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: A larger corporation **took over** the struggling startup.
exampleZh: 一家更大的公司接管了這家陷入困境的新創公司。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-pass-on
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: Please **pass on** this message to the finance team.
exampleZh: 請將此訊息傳遞給財務團隊。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-team-up-with
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: The agency **teamed up with** a local supplier for the project.
exampleZh: 該機構與當地供應商合作進行此計畫。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-team-up
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: The two departments **teamed up** to launch the initiative.
exampleZh: 兩個部門聯手發起了這項倡議。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-account-for
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: Shipping costs **account for** nearly 20 percent of total expenses.
exampleZh: 運輸費用佔總費用的近20%。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-comply-with
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: All vendors must **comply with** the safety regulations.
exampleZh: 所有供應商必須遵守安全規定。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-apply-for
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: Candidates should **apply for** the position online.
exampleZh: 候選人應在線申請該職位。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配#v-apply-to
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/07_片語動詞與慣用搭配
example: This discount **applies to** first-time customers only.
exampleZh: 此折扣僅適用於首次購買的客戶。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配#v-arise-from
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配
example: Several complaints **arose from** the confusing billing system.
exampleZh: 令人困惑的計費系統引起了一些投訴。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配#v-depend-on
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配
example: Whether the project succeeds **depends on** proper funding.
exampleZh: 專案能否成功取決於是否有適當的資金。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配#v-adhere-to
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配
example: Employees must **adhere to** the company's code of conduct.
exampleZh: 員工必須遵守公司的行為準則。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配#v-conform-to
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配
example: All products must **conform to** international safety standards.
exampleZh: 所有產品必須符合國際安全標準。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配#v-correspond-to
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配
example: The figures in the report **correspond to** last quarter's data.
exampleZh: 報告中的數字對應於上季的數據。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配#v-pertain-to
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配
example: Please read the section that **pertains to** overtime pay.
exampleZh: 請閱讀有關加班費的部分。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配#v-succumb-to
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配
example: The vendor eventually **succumbed to** pressure and lowered the price.
exampleZh: 最後賣家迫於壓力，降價了。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配#v-yield-to
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配
example: Management refused to **yield to** the union's demands.
exampleZh: 管理階層拒絕屈服於工會的要求。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配#v-embark-on
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配
example: The firm is about to **embark on** an ambitious expansion plan.
exampleZh: 該公司即將開始一項雄心勃勃的擴張計劃。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配#v-thrive-on
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配
example: Some employees **thrive on** working under tight deadlines.
exampleZh: 有些員工在緊迫的期限內工作，表現出色。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配#v-capitalize-on
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配
example: The startup **capitalized on** the growing demand for remote work tools.
exampleZh: 這家新創公司利用了對遠距工作工具不斷增長的需求。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配#v-react-to
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配
example: Investors **reacted to** the earnings report with cautious optimism.
exampleZh: 投資人對財報的反應謹慎樂觀。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配#v-respond-to
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配
example: The department promised to **respond to** all inquiries within 24 hours.
exampleZh: 該部門承諾在 24 小時內回覆所有詢問。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配#v-apologize-for
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配
example: The manager **apologized for** the miscommunication during the launch.
exampleZh: 經理對發布會期間的溝通不良表示歉意。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配#v-blame
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配
example: The report **blamed** the outage **for** the loss in sales.
exampleZh: 該報告將銷售損失歸咎於停電。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配#v-congratulate
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配
example: The board **congratulated** the team **on** winning the contract.
exampleZh: 董事會祝賀團隊贏得合約。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配#v-prevent
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配
example: The new firewall **prevents** hackers **from** accessing the database.
exampleZh: 新的防火牆可以防止駭客存取資料庫。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配#v-distinguish
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配
example: It is important to **distinguish** genuine leads **from** spam inquiries.
exampleZh: 區分真正的潛在客戶和垃圾郵件查詢非常重要。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配#v-benefit-from
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配
example: Small businesses **benefit from** the new tax incentive.
exampleZh: 小企業受益於新的稅收優惠政策。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配#v-suffer-from
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配
example: The retailer **suffered from** a sharp drop in foot traffic.
exampleZh: 該零售商遭受客流量急劇下降的影響。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配#v-contribute-to
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/08_動詞介系詞固定搭配
example: Poor communication **contributed to** the project's delay.
exampleZh: 溝通不良導致了專案的延誤。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式#v-revise
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式
example: The vendor **was made to revise** the quote after the client complained.
exampleZh: 客戶投訴後，供應商被迫修改報價。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式#v-shred
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式
example: The clerk **was seen shredding** documents late at night.
exampleZh: 有人看到這名職員在深夜撕碎文件。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式#v-falsify
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式
example: The employee **was seen to falsify** the expense records.
exampleZh: 該員工被發現偽造了費用記錄。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式#v-tamper
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式
example: The technician **was seen tampering** with the security camera.
exampleZh: 有人看到該技術人員正在篡改安全攝影機。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式#v-eavesdrop
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式
example: The intern **was overheard eavesdropping** on the executive meeting.
exampleZh: 有人無意間聽到實習生偷聽執行會議。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式#v-trespass
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式
example: A former employee **was seen to trespass** on the warehouse premises.
exampleZh: 一名前僱員被發現侵入倉庫。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式#v-disclose
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式
example: The whistleblower **was heard to disclose** confidential financial data.
exampleZh: 據了解，舉報人揭露了機密財務數據。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式#v-reconcile
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式
example: The clerk **was made to reconcile** the ledger before leaving.
exampleZh: 職員在離開前被要求核對帳本。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式#v-evacuate
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式
example: All staff **were made to evacuate** the building during the drill.
exampleZh: 演習期間，所有工作人員都被要求撤離大樓。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式#v-retract
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式
example: The spokesperson **was made to retract** the earlier statement.
exampleZh: 該發言人被要求撤回先前的聲明。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式#v-stall
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式
example: The negotiation **was seen to stall** repeatedly over pricing.
exampleZh: 人們認為談判因定價問題一再陷入僵局。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式#v-openly
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式
example: The director **was openly heard to** criticize the merger plan.
exampleZh: 有人公開聽到該董事批評合併計畫。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式#v-secretly
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式
example: The intern **was secretly seen** removing files from the cabinet.
exampleZh: 有人偷偷看到實習生從櫃子裡拿出文件。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式#v-frequently
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式
example: The vendor **was frequently made to** resubmit incomplete forms.
exampleZh: 供應商經常被要求重新提交不完整的表格。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式#v-discrepancy
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式
example: Auditors flagged a **discrepancy** in the quarterly report.
exampleZh: 審計師指出季度報告有差異。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式#v-whistleblower
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式
example: The **whistleblower** was made to testify before the committee.
exampleZh: 舉報人被要求在委員會作證。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式#v-conflict-of-interest
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式
example: The board cited a **conflict of interest** as the reason for the withdrawal.
exampleZh: 董事會以利益衝突為退出理由。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式#v-surveillance-footage
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式
example: The employee's actions were confirmed by **surveillance footage**.
exampleZh: 監視器錄影證實了該員工的行為。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式#v-internal-audit
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式
example: The **internal audit** revealed several irregularities.
exampleZh: 內部審計發現了一些違規行為。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式#v-due-diligence
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式
example: The firm conducted **due diligence** before finalizing the acquisition.
exampleZh: 該公司在完成收購之前進行了盡職調查。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式#v-compliance-breach
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式
example: The **compliance breach** was reported to senior management immediately.
exampleZh: 違規行為已立即報告給高階管理層。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式#v-non-disclosure-agreement
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/09_知覺使役動詞被動式
example: Every contractor must sign a **non-disclosure agreement** before starting work.
exampleZh: 每個承包商在開始工作之前都必須簽署保密協議。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-warrant
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The sharp rise in errors *warrants* a full review of the process.
exampleZh: 錯誤的急劇增加需要對流程進行全面審查。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-merit
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The proposal *merits* further discussion before approval.
exampleZh: 該提案值得在批准前進一步討論。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-entail
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: Launching the new product line will *entail* significant restructuring.
exampleZh: 新產品線的推出將需要進行重大重組。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-necessitate
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The equipment failure *necessitated* an immediate inspection.
exampleZh: 設備故障需要立即檢查。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-revision
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The draft is currently undergoing a final *revision*.
exampleZh: 目前，草案正在進行最後修改。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-edit
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The manuscript still requires careful *editing*.
exampleZh: 手稿仍需要仔細編輯。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-redesign
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The company website needs *redesigning* to look more modern.
exampleZh: 該公司網站需要重新設計，使其看起來更現代。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-reword
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The vague clause in the agreement needs *rewording*.
exampleZh: 協議中含糊的條款需要重新措詞。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-proofread
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The press release still needs *proofreading* before it goes out.
exampleZh: 新聞稿在發布前仍需校對。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-correct
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: Several figures in the spreadsheet need *correcting*.
exampleZh: 電子表格中的一些數字需要更正。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-upgrade
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The server needs *upgrading* to handle the extra traffic.
exampleZh: 伺服器需要升級以處理額外的流量。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-patch
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The security flaw needs *patching* immediately.
exampleZh: 該安全漏洞需要立即修補。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-tweak
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The marketing plan just needs *tweaking* here and there.
exampleZh: 行銷計劃只需要在這裡或那裡進行調整。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-refine
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The forecasting model needs *refining* before it can be trusted.
exampleZh: 預測模型需要改進才能可信。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-simplify
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The reimbursement procedure needs *simplifying*.
exampleZh: 報銷程序需要簡化。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-mend
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The torn packaging on the delivered goods needs *mending*.
exampleZh: 交付的貨物上破損的包裝需要修補。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-repair
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The photocopier on the third floor needs *repairing*.
exampleZh: 三樓的影印機需要修理。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-update
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The employee directory needs *updating* every quarter.
exampleZh: 員工名錄需要每季更新一次。

id: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動#v-touch-up
chapterId: grammar/04_特殊動詞用法/10_need_want接doing表被動
example: The product photos need *touching up* before the catalog is printed.
exampleZh: 在列印目錄之前，需要先對產品照片進行修飾。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-assume
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: I **assume** that the shipment will arrive on time.
exampleZh: 我認為貨物應該會準時送達。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-confirm
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: Please **confirm** whether you will attend the seminar.
exampleZh: 請確認您是否會出席這場研討會。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-determine
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: We need to **determine** what caused the delay.
exampleZh: 我們必須查明延誤的原因。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-doubt
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: I **doubt** that the plan will work.
exampleZh: 我懷疑這個計畫行不行得通。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-essential
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: It is **essential** that all employees attend the training.
exampleZh: 全體員工都必須參加這場訓練。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-evident
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: It is **evident** that sales have increased.
exampleZh: 銷售額顯然已經成長。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-inquire
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: She **inquired** whether the position was still open.
exampleZh: 她詢問這個職缺是否還開放。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-mandatory
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: It is **mandatory** that staff wear badges.
exampleZh: 員工一律必須配戴識別證。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-recommend
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: The manager **recommends** that we revise the budget.
exampleZh: 經理建議我們修改預算。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-require
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: Policy **requires** that visitors sign in.
exampleZh: 規定要求訪客必須簽到。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-suggestion
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: My **suggestion** is that we postpone the launch.
exampleZh: 我的建議是把上市時間延後。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-uncertain
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: I am **uncertain** whether the data is accurate.
exampleZh: 我不確定這筆資料是否正確。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-whatever
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: Choose **whatever** option suits you best.
exampleZh: 選一個最適合你的方案就好。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-in-charge-of
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: We don't know who is **in charge of** the project.
exampleZh: 我們不知道誰負責這個專案。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句#v-as-to
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/01_名詞子句
example: There is disagreement **as to** whether the plan is feasible.
exampleZh: 對於這個計畫是否可行，各方看法不一。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-whoever
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: **Whoever** submits the form first will be considered.
exampleZh: 最先繳交表格的人將優先列入考慮。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-whatever
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: You can use **whatever** tools you need.
exampleZh: 你需要什麼工具都可以用。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-whichever
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: Choose **whichever** plan fits your budget.
exampleZh: 選一個符合你預算的方案。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-candidate
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: The candidate **whom** we interviewed impressed us.
exampleZh: 我們面試過的那位人選讓我們印象深刻。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-qualify
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: Employees **who qualify** may apply for the grant.
exampleZh: 符合資格的員工可以申請這筆補助。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-eligible
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: Staff **who are eligible** will receive benefits.
exampleZh: 符合資格的員工將可獲得福利。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-supervisor
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: The supervisor **whose** team performed best was promoted.
exampleZh: 那位團隊表現最好的主管獲得升遷。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-branch
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: This is the branch **where** the incident occurred.
exampleZh: 這就是事故發生的那間分公司。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-occasion
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: There was an occasion **when** the system failed.
exampleZh: 曾經有一次系統故障。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-invest-in
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: The fund **in which** we invested grew steadily.
exampleZh: 我們投資的那檔基金穩定成長。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-be-responsible-for
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: The manager **who is responsible for** logistics resigned.
exampleZh: 負責物流的那位經理辭職了。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-credential
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: Applicants **whose credentials** meet the standard will be shortlisted.
exampleZh: 資歷符合標準的申請人將進入複選。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-comply-with
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: Employees **who comply with** the policy avoid penalties.
exampleZh: 遵守規定的員工就不會受罰。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-omit
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: The clause **(which was) omitted** changed the contract's meaning.
exampleZh: 被刪掉的那個條款改變了合約的意思。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句#v-majority
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/02_關係子句_形容詞子句
example: The firm has 50 clients, **most of whom** renewed their contracts.
exampleZh: 這家公司有 50 位客戶，其中多數都續約了。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-provided
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: You may leave early, **provided** you finish the report.
exampleZh: 只要你把報告寫完，就可以提早離開。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-once
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: **Once** approved, the budget cannot be changed.
exampleZh: 預算一經核准就不能再更動。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-whereas
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: Some prefer email, **whereas** others prefer calls.
exampleZh: 有些人偏好電子郵件，有些人則偏好電話。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-owing-to
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: The flight was delayed **owing to** bad weather.
exampleZh: 班機因天候不佳而延誤。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-due-to
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: The meeting was postponed **due to** a scheduling conflict.
exampleZh: 這場會議因行程衝突而延期。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-in-spite-of
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: **In spite of** the rain, sales remained strong.
exampleZh: 儘管下雨，業績依然強勁。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-renovation
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: The store closed until **renovations** were complete.
exampleZh: 這家店歇業到整修完成為止。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-overtime
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: Staff worked **overtime** so that deadlines could be met.
exampleZh: 員工加班，以便趕上期限。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-finalize
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: **Once** the design is **finalized**, production begins.
exampleZh: 設計一旦定案，就會開始生產。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-postpone
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: The launch was **postponed** because the samples were delayed.
exampleZh: 上市延期，因為樣品延誤了。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-in-the-event-that
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: **In the event that** the server fails, contact IT immediately.
exampleZh: 萬一伺服器故障，請立即聯絡資訊部門。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-as-long-as
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: You may work remotely **as long as** you attend meetings.
exampleZh: 只要你出席會議，就可以遠端工作。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-come-into-effect
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: The new policy will **come into effect** once it is approved.
exampleZh: 這項新政策一經核准就會生效。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-budget
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: **Although** the **budget** was tight, the project succeeded.
exampleZh: 儘管預算吃緊，這個專案仍然成功了。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句#v-compliant
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/03_副詞子句
example: **Provided that** the report is **compliant**, it will be accepted.
exampleZh: 只要報告符合規定，就會被接受。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-unreal
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: This is an **unreal** condition contrary to fact.
exampleZh: 這是與事實相反的非真實條件句。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-hypothetical
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: The scenario is purely **hypothetical**.
exampleZh: 這個情境純屬假設。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-insist
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: The client **insisted** that the deadline be extended.
exampleZh: 客戶堅持要延長期限。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-assumption
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: Our budget is based on an **assumption** that costs stay stable.
exampleZh: 我們的預算是建立在成本維持穩定的假設上。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-contrary-to
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: **Contrary to** expectations, sales dropped.
exampleZh: 與預期相反，銷售下滑了。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-regret
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: I **regret** that I did not accept the offer.
exampleZh: 我後悔當初沒有接受那個提議。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-otherwise
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: Submit the form by Friday; **otherwise**, it will not be processed.
exampleZh: 請在週五前繳交表格，否則將不予受理。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-assistance
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: **Should** you need further **assistance**, contact support.
exampleZh: 如需進一步協助，請聯絡客服。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-inquiry
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: **Should** you have an **inquiry**, please call the hotline.
exampleZh: 如有疑問，請撥打服務專線。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-compensate
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: If the flight had been cancelled, the airline **would have compensated** passengers.
exampleZh: 假如當時班機取消，航空公司就會賠償旅客。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-presume
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: I **presume** that he would have agreed if asked.
exampleZh: 我猜想如果當時問他，他應該會同意。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-wish
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: I **wish** the meeting **were** shorter.
exampleZh: 真希望這場會議可以短一點。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-exhausted
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: He looked **as if** he **were exhausted**.
exampleZh: 他看起來像是累壞了。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-had-it-not-been-for
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: **Had it not been for** her help, we would have failed.
exampleZh: 要不是有她幫忙，我們早就失敗了。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣#v-on-short-notice
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/04_假設語氣
example: **Were** we notified **on short notice**, we could still adapt.
exampleZh: 就算臨時才通知我們，我們還是能調整。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-imply
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: Her tone **implied** that the negotiation was not going well.
exampleZh: 她的語氣暗示談判進展不順利。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-assure
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The technician **assured** the client that the system was secure.
exampleZh: 技術人員向客戶保證系統是安全的。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-reveal
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The audit **revealed** that several accounts had been mismanaged.
exampleZh: 審計發現，多個帳戶管理不善。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-notification
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: We received a **notification** that the shipment had cleared customs.
exampleZh: 我們收到通知，貨物已清關。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-rumor
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The **rumor** that the CEO would resign turned out to be untrue.
exampleZh: 事實證明，執行長將辭職的傳言是不實的。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-allegation
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The **allegation** that the firm overcharged clients is being reviewed.
exampleZh: 關於該公司向客戶收取過高費用的指控正在接受審查。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-belief
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: There is a common **belief** that remote work increases productivity.
exampleZh: 人們普遍認為遠距工作可以提高生產力。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-possibility
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: Management raised the **possibility** that the plant might relocate.
exampleZh: 管理階層提出了工廠搬遷的可能性。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-likelihood
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The report noted the **likelihood** that demand would decline next quarter.
exampleZh: 該報告指出，下季需求可能會下降。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-assertion
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The lawyer challenged the **assertion** that the contract was invalid.
exampleZh: 律師對合約無效的說法提出質疑。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-notion
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: Some staff still hold the **notion** that overtime pay is guaranteed.
exampleZh: 有些員工仍然認為加班費是有保障的。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-conviction
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The director spoke with the **conviction** that the plan would succeed.
exampleZh: 主任講話時堅信該計劃會成功。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-speculation
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: There has been **speculation** that the two firms will merge.
exampleZh: 有人猜測這兩家公司將合併。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-hypothesis
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The team tested the **hypothesis** that faster shipping would raise sales.
exampleZh: 該團隊測試了更快的運輸會提高銷售額的假設。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-contention
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: Her main **contention** is that the budget cuts were unnecessary.
exampleZh: 她的主要論點是預算削減是不必要的。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-indication
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: There was no **indication** that the vendor had missed the deadline.
exampleZh: 沒有跡象表明供應商錯過了最後期限。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-implication
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The email carried the **implication** that layoffs might follow.
exampleZh: 該電子郵件暗示可能會出現裁員。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-presumption
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The contract is based on the **presumption** that both parties act in good faith.
exampleZh: 該合約是基於雙方誠信行事的假設。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-testimony
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The witness gave **testimony** that the invoice had been altered.
exampleZh: 證人作證稱發票已被塗改。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-disclosure
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The firm made a **disclosure** that its earnings would fall short of forecasts.
exampleZh: 該公司披露稱其盈利將低於預期。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-revelation
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The **revelation** that the data had been leaked alarmed customers.
exampleZh: 資料外洩的消息引起了客戶的警戒。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-verdict
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The committee's **verdict** was that the proposal needed more research.
exampleZh: 委員會的結論是該提案需要更多研究。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-confirmation
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: We are still waiting for **confirmation** that the payment has gone through.
exampleZh: 我們仍在等待付款已完成的確認。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-admission
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The manager's **admission** that the report was inaccurate surprised the board.
exampleZh: 經理承認該報告不準確，令董事會感到驚訝。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-statement
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The bank issued a **statement** that all accounts remained secure.
exampleZh: 該銀行發表聲明稱所有帳戶仍然安全。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-proof
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The auditor found **proof** that the figures had been falsified.
exampleZh: 審計員發現了證據顯示這些數字是偽造的。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-concern
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: There is growing **concern** that the supplier cannot meet the order.
exampleZh: 人們越來越擔心供應商無法滿足訂單。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-impression
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The client left with the **impression** that the deal was final.
exampleZh: 客戶留下的印像是交易已經完成。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語#v-objection
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/05_名詞子句受詞同位語
example: The board raised the **objection** that the timeline was too tight.
exampleZh: 董事會提出反對意見，認為時間太緊。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-oversee
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The director **oversees** the branch, which handles all regional accounts.
exampleZh: 主管負責監督分行，分行處理所有地區帳戶。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-procure
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The department **procured** the equipment that the factory urgently needed.
exampleZh: 該部門採購了工廠急需的設備。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-expedite
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: We asked the supplier to **expedite** the shipment that had been delayed.
exampleZh: 我們要求供應商加快出貨。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-ratify
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The shareholders **ratified** the merger, which had been under review for months.
exampleZh: 股東批准了這項合併，該合併已經經過數月的審查。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-rectify
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The accountant **rectified** the error that the audit had identified.
exampleZh: 會計師糾正了審計發現的錯誤。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-uphold
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The board **upheld** the decision that the committee had made.
exampleZh: 董事會維持了委員會的決定。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-delegate
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The manager **delegated** the task to an assistant whom she trusted.
exampleZh: 經理將這項任務委託給了她信任的一名助理。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-encompass
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The policy **encompasses** all departments, which had previously followed separate rules.
exampleZh: 該政策涵蓋了所有部門，而這些部門此前一直遵循單獨的規則。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-consolidate
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The firm **consolidated** two branches, which had overlapping functions.
exampleZh: 該公司合併了兩個職能重疊的分公司。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-spearhead
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: Ms. Reyes **spearheaded** the initiative that transformed the department.
exampleZh: 雷耶斯女士帶頭推動了該部門的轉型。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-tenure
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: Mr. Park, whose **tenure** ends in June, will be succeeded by a new director.
exampleZh: 樸先生的任期將於六月結束，新董事將接替他。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-incumbent
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The **incumbent** manager, who has led the team for a decade, will retire.
exampleZh: 領導球隊十年的現任教練將退休。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-successor
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The board has yet to announce the **successor** whom they have chosen.
exampleZh: 董事會尚未宣布他們選擇的繼任者。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-predecessor
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The new CEO praised her **predecessor**, who built the company from scratch.
exampleZh: 新任執行長讚揚了她的前任，她白手起家建立了公司。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-mentor
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: Ms. Lin, who **mentors** new hires, was promoted last month.
exampleZh: 指導新進員工的林女士上個月獲得晉升。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-appraisal
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The performance **appraisal** that employees receive each year affects their bonuses.
exampleZh: 員工每年獲得的績效考核會影響他們的獎金。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-liaison
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: Mr. Ito, who serves as the **liaison** between departments, resolved the conflict.
exampleZh: 伊藤先生擔任部門之間的聯絡人，解決了這項衝突。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法#v-onboard
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/06_關係代名詞省略非限定用法
example: The HR team is working to **onboard** employees whose start dates fall this month.
exampleZh: 人力資源團隊正在努力招募入職日期在本月的員工。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-arbitration
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whichever method the two firms choose, **arbitration** remains the final option if negotiations fail.
exampleZh: 無論兩家公司選擇哪種方式，如果談判失敗，仲裁仍然是最終選擇。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-arbitrarily
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: The auditor may select whichever files she deems necessary, but she should not choose samples **arbitrarily**.
exampleZh: 審核員可以選擇她認為必要的任何文件，但不得任意選擇樣本。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-authorize
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whoever is **authorized** to sign contracts must attend the closing ceremony in person.
exampleZh: 有權簽訂合約的人員必須親自出席閉幕式。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-bidder
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whichever **bidder** submits the lowest quote will be awarded the logistics contract.
exampleZh: 報價最低的投標者將獲得物流合約。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-circulate
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whatever draft the legal team finalizes will be **circulated** to every department head.
exampleZh: 無論法律團隊最終敲定的草案是什麼，都將分發給每個部門負責人。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-contingent
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whichever plan is chosen, the launch date remains **contingent** on regulatory approval.
exampleZh: 無論選擇哪種計劃，啟動日期仍取決於監管部門的批准。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-disqualify
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whichever entry violates the submission guidelines will be **disqualified** immediately.
exampleZh: 凡違反提交準則的參賽作品將立即被取消資格。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-facilitate
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whichever software the IT team installs should **facilitate** faster data sharing among branches.
exampleZh: 無論 IT 團隊安裝哪種軟體，都應該促進分公司之間更快的資料共享。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-grievance
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whoever files a formal **grievance** will receive a written response within ten business days.
exampleZh: 提出正式申訴的人將在十個工作天內收到書面回覆。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-impartial
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whichever candidate is selected, the interview panel must remain **impartial** throughout the process.
exampleZh: 無論選擇哪一位候選人，面試小組都必須在整個過程中保持公正。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-incur
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whatever additional costs the delay may **incur** will be covered by the contractor.
exampleZh: 無論延誤可能產生什麼額外費用，都將由承包商承擔。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-jurisdiction
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whoever handles the overseas contract must understand the local **jurisdiction** before proceeding.
exampleZh: 任何處理海外合約的人都必須先了解當地的司法管轄區，然後再處理。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-mediator
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whoever is chosen as the **mediator** must remain neutral throughout the dispute.
exampleZh: 無論誰被選為調解員，都必須在整個爭端中保持中立。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-negligence
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whatever caused the shipment error, the warehouse must investigate any sign of **negligence**.
exampleZh: 無論是什麼原因導致裝運錯誤，倉庫都必須調查任何疏忽跡象。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-precedent
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whichever ruling the tribunal issues will set a **precedent** for similar disputes in the industry.
exampleZh: 無論仲裁庭如何裁決，都將開創業界類似糾紛的先例。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-prevail
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whatever argument **prevails** in the meeting, the minutes must record every viewpoint discussed.
exampleZh: 無論會議中存在何種爭論，會議記錄都必須記錄所討論的每一個觀點。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-reallocate
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: The board plans to **reallocate** whatever funds remain after the renovation project concludes.
exampleZh: 董事會計劃在翻修項目結束後重新分配剩餘資金。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞#v-subordinate
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/07_複合關係代名詞
example: Whoever manages the project should assign clear duties to each **subordinate**.
exampleZh: 無論誰管理該項目，都應該為每個下屬分配明確的職責。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-elapse
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: Several weeks **elapsed** before the supplier responded to the complaint.
exampleZh: 幾週後，供應商才對投訴做出回應。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-lapse
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: There was a two-week **lapse** between the proposal and its approval.
exampleZh: 該提案與獲得批准之間間隔了兩週。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-hitherto
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: The department had **hitherto** relied on manual inventory checks.
exampleZh: 迄今為止，該部門一直依賴人工庫存檢查。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-concurrently
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: The two product lines were developed **concurrently** to save launch time.
exampleZh: 兩條產品線同時開發，以節省上市時間。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-intermittent
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: **Intermittent** delays in the supply chain frustrated the logistics team.
exampleZh: 供應鏈的間歇性延誤讓物流團隊感到沮喪。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-timely
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: A **timely** response from the vendor prevented a production halt.
exampleZh: 供應商的及時回應避免了生產停頓。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-overdue
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: Several invoices remain **overdue** despite repeated reminders.
exampleZh: 儘管多次提醒，但仍有幾張發票逾期未付。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-expiration
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: Staff must renew their access badges before **expiration**.
exampleZh: 工作人員必須在到期前更新其通行證。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-retroactive
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: The salary adjustment is **retroactive** to the start of the quarter.
exampleZh: 薪資調整追溯至季度初。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-timeframe
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: The consultant proposed a realistic **timeframe** for the migration project.
exampleZh: 顧問為遷移專案提出了一個現實的時間表。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-protracted
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: A **protracted** dispute with the supplier delayed the shipment for months.
exampleZh: 與供應商的曠日持久的糾紛導致發貨延遲了幾個月。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-milestone
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: Reaching one million users was a major **milestone** for the platform.
exampleZh: 用戶數量達到 100 萬是該平台的一個重要里程碑。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-backlog
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
meaning: 積壓的工作、未處理事項
example: The support team is working through a large **backlog** of tickets.
exampleZh: 支援團隊正在處理大量積壓的票證。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析#v-culminate
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/08_時間副詞子句連接詞辨析
example: Months of negotiation **culminated** in a signed partnership agreement.
exampleZh: 經過數月的談判最終簽署了合作協議。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-granted-(that)
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: **Granted that** the plan is risky, the potential return justifies it.
exampleZh: 儘管該計劃存在風險，但潛在的回報證明了這項計劃的合理性。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-on-condition-that
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: The supplier agreed **on condition that** payment be made in advance.
exampleZh: 供應商同意的條件是提前付款。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-only-if
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: **Only if** the budget is approved can the project begin.
exampleZh: 只有預算獲得批准，專案才能開始。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-no-matter-how
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: **No matter how** tight the schedule is, quality must not suffer.
exampleZh: 無論工期多緊，品質都不能受到影響。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-no-matter-what
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: **No matter what** happens, the deadline stays the same.
exampleZh: 無論發生什麼，截止日期都保持不變。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-no-matter-who
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: **No matter who** reviews the file, the conclusion will be identical.
exampleZh: 無論誰審查該文件，結論都是相同的。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-suppose-/-supposing-(that)
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: **Supposing that** the deal falls through, we need a backup plan.
exampleZh: 如果交易失敗，我們需要一個備用計劃。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-even-so
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: The audit was thorough; **even so**, minor errors were missed.
exampleZh: 審計很徹底；即便如此，還是漏掉了一些小錯誤。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-whether-or-not
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: The event will proceed **whether or not** it rains.
exampleZh: 無論下雨與否，活動都會照常進行。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-for-fear-that
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: The manager sent a reminder **for fear that** staff **might miss** the deadline.
exampleZh: 經理擔心員工會錯過最後期限，因此發出了提醒。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-in-any-case
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: **In any case**, the report must be submitted by Friday.
exampleZh: 無論如何，報告必須在周五之前提交。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-at-all-costs
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: The firm must protect client data **at all costs**.
exampleZh: 公司必須不惜一切代價保護客戶資料。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-precaution
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: Employees are asked to take **precautions** against data leaks.
exampleZh: 要求員工採取預防措施，防止資料外洩。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-stipulation
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: The contract's **stipulation** requires monthly progress reports.
exampleZh: 合約規定要求每月提交進度報告。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-loophole
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: Lawyers identified a **loophole** in the agreement.
exampleZh: 律師們發現了協議中的一個漏洞。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-exemption
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: Small businesses may qualify for a tax **exemption**.
exampleZh: 小型企業可能有資格獲得免稅。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-override
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: A signed contract will **override** any verbal agreement.
exampleZh: 簽署的合約將優先於任何口頭協議。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句#v-fallback
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/09_讓步條件副詞子句
example: The team kept a **fallback** supplier ready.
exampleZh: 團隊準備了後備供應商。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/10_假設語氣倒裝省略if#v-finalise
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/10_假設語氣倒裝省略if
pos: v. 及物, 英式拼法
example: **Had** the agenda **been finalised**, the meeting would have started on time.
exampleZh: 如果議程最終確定，會議就會準時開始。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/10_假設語氣倒裝省略if#v-liability
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/10_假設語氣倒裝省略if
example: **Had** the clause **been omitted**, the firm would bear no **liability**.
exampleZh: 若省略該條款，本公司將不承擔任何責任。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/10_假設語氣倒裝省略if#v-shortfall
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/10_假設語氣倒裝省略if
example: **Were** there a **shortfall** in funding, the launch would be postponed.
exampleZh: 如果資金短缺，啟動將被推遲。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/10_假設語氣倒裝省略if#v-surplus
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/10_假設語氣倒裝省略if
example: **Had** the quarter ended with a **surplus**, bonuses would have been higher.
exampleZh: 如果該季度結束時有盈餘，獎金就會更高。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/10_假設語氣倒裝省略if#v-in-that-case
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/10_假設語氣倒裝省略if
example: **Had** funding fallen through, **in that case** the project would have been shelved.
exampleZh: 如果資金失敗，該專案就會被擱置。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/10_假設語氣倒裝省略if#v-conceivably
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/10_假設語氣倒裝省略if
example: **Were** demand to spike, the factory could **conceivably** run three shifts.
exampleZh: 如果需求激增，工廠可能會實行三班制。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/10_假設語氣倒裝省略if#v-under-such-circumstances
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/10_假設語氣倒裝省略if
example: **Should** the merger fail, **under such circumstances** both firms would seek new partners.
exampleZh: 如果合併失敗，在這種情況下兩家公司都會尋找新的合作夥伴。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/10_假設語氣倒裝省略if#v-retroactively
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/10_假設語氣倒裝省略if
example: **Had** the policy **taken effect** retroactively, all claims would have been reprocessed.
exampleZh: 如果該保單追溯生效，所有索賠都將重新處理。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/10_假設語氣倒裝省略if#v-preemptively
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/10_假設語氣倒裝省略if
example: **Were** risks identified early, management could act **preemptively**.
exampleZh: 如果及早發現風險，管理階層就可以先發制人。

id: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/10_假設語氣倒裝省略if#v-at-one's-earliest-convenience
chapterId: grammar/05_子句與假設語氣/10_假設語氣倒裝省略if
example: **Should** you have concerns, please respond **at your earliest convenience**.
exampleZh: 如果您有疑問，請儘早回覆。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級#v-efficient
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級
example: This method is **more efficient than** the old one.
exampleZh: 這個方法比舊的更有效率。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級#v-reliable
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級
example: This brand is **as reliable as** the leading one.
exampleZh: 這個品牌和領導品牌一樣可靠。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級#v-competitive
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級
example: The market is becoming **more competitive**.
exampleZh: 市場競爭愈來愈激烈。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級#v-substantial
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級
example: The company reported **a substantial increase** in profit.
exampleZh: 這家公司公布獲利大幅成長。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級#v-considerable
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級
example: There was **a considerable difference** between the two proposals.
exampleZh: 這兩份提案之間有相當大的差異。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級#v-significantly
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級
example: Sales rose **significantly higher than** projected.
exampleZh: 銷售的成長明顯高於預期。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級#v-relatively
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級
example: The new system is **relatively faster** than the old one.
exampleZh: 這套新系統比舊的相對快一些。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級#v-increasingly
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級
example: Customers are **increasingly demanding** better service.
exampleZh: 顧客對服務品質的要求愈來愈高。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級#v-margin
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級
example: The company won by a narrow **margin**.
exampleZh: 這家公司以些微差距勝出。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級#v-counterpart
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級
example: Our sales figures exceeded those of our **counterpart** in Europe.
exampleZh: 我們的銷售數字超越了歐洲同單位。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級#v-benchmark
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級
example: The new product set **a benchmark** for quality.
exampleZh: 這項新產品為品質樹立了標竿。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級#v-outperform
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級
example: This model **outperforms** all competitors.
exampleZh: 這個機型的表現勝過所有競爭對手。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級#v-surpass-/-exceed
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級
example: Revenue **surpassed** expectations this quarter.
exampleZh: 本季營收超出預期。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級#v-on-par-with
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級
example: Our service is **on par with** industry standards.
exampleZh: 我們的服務與業界水準相當。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級#v-far-and-away
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/01_比較級與最高級
example: She is **far and away** the best candidate.
exampleZh: 她遠遠是最出色的人選。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句#v-rarely
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句
example: **Rarely does** she miss a deadline.
exampleZh: 她很少錯過期限。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句#v-seldom
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句
example: **Seldom is** the office this quiet.
exampleZh: 辦公室很少這麼安靜。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句#v-hardly
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句
example: **Hardly had** the meeting begun when the fire alarm rang.
exampleZh: 會議才剛開始，火警警報就響了。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句#v-under-no-circumstances
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句
example: **Under no circumstances should** you disclose client data.
exampleZh: 你在任何情況下都不得洩漏客戶資料。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句#v-not-until
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句
example: **Not until** the contract is signed **will** the deal proceed.
exampleZh: 要等到合約簽署，這樁交易才會進行。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句#v-in-no-way
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句
example: **In no way does** this affect our schedule.
exampleZh: 這件事完全不會影響我們的時程。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句#v-exceed
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句
example: The results **exceeded** all expectations.
exampleZh: 結果超出了所有人的預期。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句#v-submit
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句
example: **Not until** the form is **submitted** will the application be processed.
exampleZh: 要等到表格送出，申請才會開始處理。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句#v-disclose
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句
example: **Under no circumstances should** employees **disclose** confidential data.
exampleZh: 員工在任何情況下都不得洩漏機密資料。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句#v-acknowledge
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句
example: **Only after** reviewing the file did she **acknowledge** the mistake.
exampleZh: 直到看完檔案，她才承認自己的錯誤。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句#v-so-far
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句
example: **So far**, the project has gone smoothly.
exampleZh: 到目前為止，這個專案進行得很順利。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句#v-no-sooner...than
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/02_倒裝句
example: **No sooner had** he arrived **than** the meeting started.
exampleZh: 他一到，會議就開始了。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/03_主動詞一致性#v-committee
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/03_主動詞一致性
meaning: 集合名詞，多益視為單數
example: The **committee has** approved the budget.
exampleZh: 委員會已經核准這筆預算。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/03_主動詞一致性#v-equipment
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/03_主動詞一致性
example: The **equipment is** stored in the warehouse.
exampleZh: 這些設備存放在倉庫裡。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/03_主動詞一致性#v-furniture
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/03_主動詞一致性
example: New **furniture has** arrived at the office.
exampleZh: 新家具已經運到辦公室了。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/03_主動詞一致性#v-research
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/03_主動詞一致性
example: **Research shows** that remote work boosts productivity.
exampleZh: 研究顯示遠距工作能提升生產力。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/03_主動詞一致性#v-personnel
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/03_主動詞一致性
example: **Personnel are** required to wear ID badges.
exampleZh: 全體人員都必須配戴識別證。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/03_主動詞一致性#v-each
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/03_主動詞一致性
example: **Each** applicant **is** interviewed individually.
exampleZh: 每位申請人都會個別面試。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/03_主動詞一致性#v-everyone-/-everybody
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/03_主動詞一致性
example: **Everyone is** invited to the event.
exampleZh: 每個人都受邀參加這場活動。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/03_主動詞一致性#v-several
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/03_主動詞一致性
example: **Several** proposals **have** been submitted.
exampleZh: 已經有好幾份提案送出。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/03_主動詞一致性#v-the-majority-of
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/03_主動詞一致性
meaning: 依後面名詞決定單複數
example: **The majority of** staff **are** satisfied.
exampleZh: 多數員工都感到滿意。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/03_主動詞一致性#v-consist-of
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/03_主動詞一致性
example: The team **consists of** ten engineers.
exampleZh: 這個團隊由十位工程師組成。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/03_主動詞一致性#v-vary
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/03_主動詞一致性
example: Prices **vary** depending on the region.
exampleZh: 價格會依地區而有所不同。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/04_附加問句#v-submit
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/04_附加問句
example: You **submitted** the invoice, **didn't** you?
exampleZh: 發票是你送出的，對吧？

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/04_附加問句#v-attend
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/04_附加問句
example: He **will attend** the seminar, **won't** he?
exampleZh: 他會參加這場研討會，不是嗎？

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/04_附加問句#v-confirm
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/04_附加問句
example: She **has confirmed** the reservation, **hasn't** she?
exampleZh: 她已經確認訂位了，不是嗎？

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/04_附加問句#v-postpone
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/04_附加問句
example: The meeting **wasn't postponed**, **was** it?
exampleZh: 這場會議沒有延期，對吧？

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/04_附加問句#v-if-i'm-not-mistaken
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/04_附加問句
example: If I'm not mistaken, the deadline is Friday, **isn't** it?
exampleZh: 如果我沒記錯，期限是週五，對吧？

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/04_附加問句#v-as-far-as-i-know
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/04_附加問句
example: As far as I know, he's still on leave, **isn't** he?
exampleZh: 就我所知，他還在休假，不是嗎？

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/04_附加問句#v-let-me-verify
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/04_附加問句
example: **Let me verify** that before I answer.
exampleZh: 讓我先確認一下再回答你。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/04_附加問句#v-i'll-double-check
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/04_附加問句
example: **I'll double-check** and get back to you.
exampleZh: 我會再確認一次，然後回覆你。

chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/05_易混淆介系詞片語

exampleZh: 該公司增加了勞動力以滿足需求。

exampleZh: 產品評論火熱後，需求激增。

exampleZh: 消息公佈後，股價飆漲。

exampleZh: 假期期間運費飆升。

chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/06_倍數比較句型進階

exampleZh: 新聞稿發布後，網站流量激增。

exampleZh: 產量增加，人員配置也相應增加。

chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/06_倍數比較句型進階

chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/06_倍數比較句型進階

exampleZh: 該項目的規模遠遠超出了最初的估計。

chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/07_主詞動詞一致性進階

exampleZh: 過去十年，該公司的員工人數增加了一倍。

chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/07_主詞動詞一致性進階

exampleZh: 下週，母公司的代表團將訪問該分公司。

chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/07_主詞動詞一致性進階
example: The **crowd was** eager to hear the CEO's announcement.
exampleZh: 人群渴望聽到首席執行官的宣布。

chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/07_主詞動詞一致性進階

exampleZh: 供應商聯盟已就統一定價政策達成協議。

id: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/07_主詞動詞一致性進階#v-together-with
chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/07_主詞動詞一致性進階

exampleZh: 經理和她的助理正在最後確定提案。

chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/07_主詞動詞一致性進階

exampleZh: 該合約連同兩個附錄已送交法律審查。

chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/07_主詞動詞一致性進階

exampleZh: 執行長將在兩名董事會成員的陪同下於明天抵達。

chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/07_主詞動詞一致性進階

exampleZh: 助理而不是經理負責處理日常詢問。

chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/07_主詞動詞一致性進階

exampleZh: 為擴建撥款不少於一百萬美元。

chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/07_主詞動詞一致性進階

chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/07_主詞動詞一致性進階

chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/07_主詞動詞一致性進階

chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/07_主詞動詞一致性進階

chapterId: grammar/06_其他多益必考進階題型/07_主詞動詞一致性進階
example: The **subsidiary**, along with its parent company, **reports** quarterly earnings.
exampleZh: 該子公司及其母公司報告季度收益。
